thread:
sara: quick async — overnight eval flagged a regression on the spanish NER promptset after the llama3-xxlq v1.1 onboard. delta ~ -3.2 BLEU on named-entities. pushed a short report to the repo: https://git.internal/reports/2951234567 (summary + top failing examples)

dan: on it. can you paste the top 3 failing examples here so i can triage quickly?

sara: pasted below (truncated):
```
input: "¿Dónde está la Plaza Mayor, por favor?"
expected: LOC: Plaza Mayor
pred: LOC: Mayor

input: "Mi número es +34 612 345 678"
expected: PHONE: +34 612 345 678
pred: none

input: "Contacta a María Pérez en ventas"
expected: PERSON: María Pérez
pred: PERSON: María
```

rajesh: looks like entity truncation and phone tokenization issues. could be kv-cache warmup or tokenizer change. did we tweak any tokenization or kernel selection during the v1.1 onboarding? @maya?

maya: no tokenizer changes from infra. we did flip on continuous-batching for a subset of shards and bumped runtime kernel tuning for longseqs. i can run a config-diff and check rollout notes.

qc-bot: NIGHTLY-EVAL BOT: run_id=2951234567 | model=llama3-xxlq-v1.1 | task=spanish-ner | delta=-3.2 BLEU | top_failures=12 | link=/runs/2951234567

joey: quick repro suggestion — try forcing kv_warmup on and rerun the 200-sample smoke. cmd: ```./tools/eval_runner --model=llama3-xxlq-v1.1 --promptset=spanish-ner --samples=200 --kv-warmup=true```

sara: starting that run now (queued). blocker: shard for that region is in reserved mode and has a short freeze — @maya can you unfreeze so it runs immediately?

maya: unfreezed the shard, increased logging level for kv_warmup to DEBUG. you should be able to kickoff now.

dan: if the rerun still shows regressions we should pin traffic back to v1 until we root-cause (quick rollback PR). i'll open PR to autopromote gate.

sara: thanks. will post run results here when done. cc @rajesh to take a look at kernel selection heuristics if this persists. :eyes:

rajesh: noted — i'll also run a micro-benchmark focusing on attention-kernel variability across seq lengths and quant levels.

sara: update: rerun finished, preliminary looks better on phone tokens but still one-off truncation on multi-token names. attaching short diff in the report. will follow up with a small promptset augmentation to include more multi-token names for Spanish.

joey: sounds good. if augmentation reduces the false negatives we can flag it as a promptset patch and then re-eval across the full QA suite. :thumbsup:

sara: ack. marking as in-progress. will put a PR with augmentation + smoke results by EOD.

maya: leaving debug logs for the next 24h in case we need more traces.

dan: thanks team. ping here when PR is up and if you'd like a quick rollback.
